meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 OpenCode 作为编码 agent,接入多家模型服务。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让 OpenCode 充当编码 agent,且需要接入多家模型服务。
copy.tagline_en: Set up OpenCode as a coding agent to connect to multiple LLM providers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use OpenCode as your coding agent with multiple model backends.

howto.what: 装好后,NanoClaw 会把 OpenCode 当作可选的智能体后端:每个分组可以用 ncl 命令把 provider 指定为 opencode,从而经 OpenCode 接入 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等模型;启动容器时宿主机会传入 OPENCODE_* 环境变量和 XDG 挂载。
howto.when: 当你要接入 OpenCode 作为模型后端,或要为一个已存在的分组把 provider 改成 opencode 并重启时,会用到这套安装与配置流程;首次安装会检查必要文件是否已有,缺失才补,可重复运行。

say.text: 切换 provider 后帮我迁移记忆
say.note: 会运行 /migrate-memory,把记忆带到新后端。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw treats OpenCode as an optional agent backend: each group can set provider to opencode via ncl, letting OpenCode route to OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc. When spawning containers, the host passes OPENCODE_* env vars and the XDG mount.
howto.when_en: This install/config flow runs when you want OpenCode as the model backend or need to switch an existing group's provider to opencode and restart. Preflight checks skip steps if files are already present; re-running is safe.

say_en.text: Switch group <group-id> to the opencode provider and restart it.
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update --provider opencode and restarts the group.

say_en.text: Configure the OPENCODE_* env vars using the DeepSeek example.
say_en.note: Writes .env entries; a OneCLI secret must also be registered.

say_en.text: Migrate my memory after switching provider.
